A1.justification: Both PDFs describe MeshPad and contain complete, readable main text and Appendices A–G. Matching equations, figures, tables, and references support a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v3 reports original mesh-generation and editing experiments, speculator ablations, and a 35-participant perceptual study. Appendices D–G include additional qualitative results, topology statistics, and user-rating statistics.

after.justification: v4 retains the original quantitative experiments, ablations, perceptual study, and supplementary empirical results in Appendices D–G.

M1.justification: Sections 3.1–3.4 retain the same mesh addition/deletion procedures, OPT and RADIO architecture, losses, jointly trained vertex-aligned speculator, and training-data generation method.

E1.justification: Both versions use ShapeNet, IKEA, the 50-shape sketch-editing evaluation set, and Objaverse and DeformingThings4D fine-tuning examples. The image-conditioning and other qualitative test scenarios in the appendices are also unchanged.

E2.justification: The corresponding comparisons retain LAS, SENS, LAS-MA, and SENS-MA, where MA denotes MeshAnythingV2 post-processing. Table 4 also retains the same three ablation variants; no comparator is added or removed.

E3.justification: Dataset splits, preprocessing, training budgets, evaluation views, metrics, and baseline-specific category restrictions are unchanged. Both versions retain the first-300-token timing procedure and the same 35-participant study design.

E4.justification: Table 4 retains the same speculator, vertex-alignment, and joint-training ablations. The novelty analysis, interactive versus single-step generation, image conditioning, direct editing, sketch-alignment examples, and topology analysis are unchanged.

E5.justification: Appendix G and Table 6 retain the same reporting of user-rating standard deviations. No repeated-run information, seeds, confidence intervals, or significance-testing procedures are added or revised.

E6.justification: All entries in Tables 1–6 and the qualitative findings are unchanged. For example, Table 1 retains MeshPad CD values of 6.20 on ShapeNet and 6.78 on IKEA, while Table 4 retains 131.1 tokens/second and the reported 2.16-fold speedup.

T1.justification: Equations 1–9 and their associated mathematical definitions are unchanged, including mesh partitioning, token prediction, triangle-chain decoding, and volume sampling. No assumptions, derivations, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about interactive localized mesh editing, mesh quality and user preference, and accelerated generation without quality loss. The stated contributions do not change in scope or meaning.

C2.justification: Both versions retain the same explanations of joint training, vertex alignment, and topology results. The context-length limitation, weaker image-conditioned performance, and lack of guaranteed exact sketch alignment are also unchanged.

D1.justification: Section 4.1 and Appendices A–C retain the same implementation, hyperparameter, data-processing, and interface details, including four A100 GPUs and the stated training times. Project-page and supplementary-material access disclosures are unchanged.

R1.justification: The same 66 references are retained, and Section 2 preserves the same positioning relative to mesh generation, conditional generation, shape editing, and speculative decoding. No cited work or substantive novelty comparison changes.

P1.justification: The arXiv stamp changes from v3 dated 9 August 2025 to v4 dated 18 June 2026. Embedded author metadata changes 'Vladyslav Rozov' to 'Vladislav Rosov', already used in the visible byline. The prose, headings, and document organization are unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures 1–14 and Tables 1–6 retain the same content, captions, labels, structures, and locations. Visual inspection confirms the same page layout, apart from negligible glyph-rendering differences.

improvement.justification: v4 preserves the scientific content, experimental evidence, limitations, and exposition of v3, including Appendices A–G. The version/date update and author-metadata correction do not materially change the paper's overall quality.
